grades.quote: sleep() marks the calling process as SLEEPING (not RUNNABLE) and releases the CPU by context-switching to the scheduler, so that other processes can run.
grades.reason: The passage describes only the sleeping side (xv6 sleep/wakeup, wait channels, condition lock, lost wake-ups). It says sleeping releases the CPU so other processes can run. It does not discuss spinning on a contended lock, and it does not compare spin locks with sleeping locks. It gives limited background on the sleeping half of the comparison.
